subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add an N-turn session model lease for `/model --turns`, and should it share the temporary model contract with the one-turn override work in #83565/#100876?
rationale: The requested behavior changes persistent session routing, command UX, config shape, provider/auth validation, and Gateway API semantics; automation cannot choose that product contract safely.

options.title: Specify a unified temporary-model lease
options.body: Design one contract that supports one-turn and N-turn overrides before any implementation changes session or Gateway state.

options.title: Limit scope to one-turn overrides
options.body: Keep #39022 open as broader future work while landing only the atomic one-turn model override path from #83565/#100876.

options.title: Keep sticky model selection only
options.body: Reject temporary leases and document that teams should switch models explicitly or use external cost controls.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified temporary-model lease
recommendation.body: Design one contract that supports one-turn and N-turn overrides before any implementation changes session or Gateway state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session and Gateway protocol work makes this the strongest available owner signal for choosing the API/session contract.
